items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: The first study job I ever worked on with Buddy Petite, that was the one in Covington, Louisiana.

ctx.x: Whose band was he with? His own?

Yeah, he used to have a band of his own, Picker Band. You know, during those times we wouldn't take a study job. It was only a few study jobs. The first study job I ever worked on with Buddy Petite, that was the one in Covington, Louisiana. That was for a few weeks. Then from there we went on, we went to Galveston, Texas. And we served there for about three months. And we went on to the first time we ever had a study job. A lot of musicians at that time wouldn't take a study job. You could make no money to take a…
